newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA M1 UP 0.4 PCT, M2 FALLS 2.0 PCT IN WEEK.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA M1 UP 0.4 PCT, M2 FALLS 2.0 PCT IN WEEK.

text.p: Bulgarian M1 money supply inched up
to 148.4 billion levs on September 27 from 147.8 billion levs
on September 20 and M2 fell to 812.7 billion levs from 832.3
billion levs, preliminary central bank figures showed.
Total broad money decreased by 2.38 percent to 846 billion
levs as lev-denominated broad money inched down 0.17 percent to
481.4 billion levs and dollar-denominated broad money fell 5.15
Hard currency-denominated term deposits of companies and
individuals totalled $ 1.464 billion on September 27, down $73
Lev-denominated term deposits of companies and individuals
fell to 273.9 billion levs on September 27 from 275.0 billion
